brief:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of "driving America into another war to stay out of jail," Middle East Eye reported. Araghchi's statement reflects Tehran's assertion that Netanyahu is seeking to escalate regional tensions with Iran.

The accusation comes amid heightened tensions between Iran and Israel, with the Iranian foreign minister suggesting Netanyahu's motivations are tied to his domestic legal troubles rather than legitimate security concerns.
dek: Araghchi says Netanyahu is pushing for renewed war on Iran Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of “driving America into another war to stay out of jail”.
title: Iran accuses Netanyahu of pushing US toward renewed war
